about: What each file in vendor/ is: its npm package and version, and its hash. scripts/check-vendor.py checks the versions against GitHub's advisory database before every release (#74).

GHSA-jrc7-96c5-q579.why: Not reachable on a radar since 2026-10-13: the advisory is MapLibre's DOM.sanitize, which only its popups and its credits control use. The page has no popups, and draws the map credits itself from its own table (attributionControl: false), so no HTML reaches MapLibre. tests/test_vendor.py keeps it that way. Until MapLibre 6.x is tested on the panel (#74).
